scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Continuation of the high-pitched, wheezing laughter track.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: The high-pitched laughter track continues, accompanied by a faint mechanical 'click' sound when the case is held open.
scenes.visual: POV over zebra crossing: hands hold matte green case with two frogs; right thumb and forefinger lift one out

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Male voice asks: "What is that?" followed by the woman's audible laughter and the continuation of the high-pitched laughter sound effect.
scenes.visual: airport security: male officer in his 40s, grey uniform, black gloves, points toward her ear, confused but smiling; woman in pink hoodie holds the case in one hand and a frog in the other, laughing
